Subject:
Declarationof Interim CashDividend for theYearEndingJune30,2021
Dear Sirs:
We have toinformyou that theBoard of Directors of KotAdduPower Company Limited (the
"Company") in their meeting held on June 9, 2021 at 10:00 a.m. at Lahore recommended the
following:
Cash Dividend:
AnInterim CashDividendyear endingJune 30,2021 at Rs.5.00per share,that is,50%.This is
in addition toInterim CashDividend(s) alreadypaid at Rs.1.50per shares i.e.15%.
The above entitlementwill bepaid to the shareholderswhosenamesappear on theRegister of
Members on July 12,2021.
TheShareTransferBooksof the Companywill be closed fromJuly13,2021 toJuly 19,2021
(both days inclusive).Transfers received at the office of the Company's Shares Registrar,THK
Associates (Private) Limited, Plot No.32-C,Jami Commercial Street 2,D.H.A.,Phase-VIl,
Kaachi-75500at the close ofbusiness onJuly12,2021 will be treated intime for purposes of
aboveentitlementtothetransferees.
